quest.title: The Most Fantastic Tournament You've Never Heard Of?
quest.description: The people of Sumeru are gradually returning to their peaceful daily lives, but you and Paimon notice a strange sign while on your way to find new commissions...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4

chapter.title: The Most Fantastic Tournament You've Never Heard Of?

talks.objective: Take a walk around Sumeru City

dialogues.speaker: Announcement Board
dialogues.text: Look no further! The first ever Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament is about to begin! We anticipate your arrival!

choices.text: Training Fungi to fight each other?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But Fungi are monsters! We can't let this go ahead! It's way too dangerous...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go check out the tournament. If it's as dangerous as it sounds, at least we'll be there to stop things from getting too out of control.

choices.text: That's a very unexpected mode of entertainment...

talks.objective: Go to the Nilotpala Cup Arena

dialogues.speaker: Kautilya
dialogues.text: Welcome, contestants, to the Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament! I am Kautilya, a senior Amurta researcher and the organizer of today's tournament.

dialogues.speaker: Kautilya
dialogues.text: I'm sure you're probably all very intrigued by the idea of fighting Fungi and excited at the prospect of our amazing prizes. But at the same time, you may well have some concerns about the safety of this tournament.

dialogues.speaker: Kautilya
dialogues.text: Worry not! The Wisdom Orb we've developed exclusively for this event makes use of Amurta's most advanced "Intellectual Boost" technology. It is absolutely reliable and safe!

dialogues.speaker: Kautilya
dialogues.text: So please, cast your reservations aside and enter the tournament with confidence!

dialogues.speaker: Kautilya
dialogues.text: Also, it gives me great pleasure to announce that this event is sponsored by Mr. Elchingen, a renowned businessman from Fontaine who has generously provided a grand total of sixty million Mora for our prize fund!

dialogues.speaker: Kautilya
dialogues.text: And if anyone is able to prove themselves capable of carrying out Mr. Elchingen's philosophy by passing the Ultimate Trial, he will be willing to give to them his entire fortune!

dialogues.speaker: Kautilya
dialogues.text: The only other condition is that the winner must agree to carry on Mr. Elchingen's legacy by hosting the "Nilotpala Cup Beast Tamers Tournament" in the future...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Paimon can't believe that rich guy threw sixty million Mora at this event, just like that! And, what was all that about inheriting his entire fortune if you promise to keep his beast-taming tournament going...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Also, hosted by an Akademiya scholar, huh? Whoa, pretty official. Uh, might be a little inappropriate if we just barged in and tried to shut it down...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, um... Why don't we enter the tournament and see if this "Wisdom Orb" thingy actually works?

choices.text: Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, that's not it! It's just... now that everything in Sumeru has finally settled down, don't you think it'd be a little unfair to Nahida if we keep picking trouble with the Akademiya?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And he sounded really confident. Paimon's curious about how this mysterious Fungi-taming device works!

choices.text: And what if it works really well?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Although they've caused us trouble in the past, the Fungi aren't just aggressive monsters, right? They're more like... wild animals with bad tempers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since there's no longer any safety concerns, we don't need to worry. Maybe we can even try becoming friends with the Fungi! Paimon thinks that would be fun!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Besides, if we do well in the tournament, we'll be able to earn some extra Mora. There are basically no drawbacks!

choices.text: Alright, let's see what all the fuss is about then...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep! That's the way we roll!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Looks like we sign up over there. C'mon, let's grab a Wisdom Orb and enter the tournament!

choices.text: But we should stay cautious, just in case...
What will you do to the Fungi?
You just want the prize money, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, looks like the people ahead of us are still signing up. Let's wait our turn.
#Golden Comet {NICKNAME} and Silver Companion... So. You're competing too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You know us? But... what's with those names? We've never heard them before...
You're a tough duo, if the posters are to be believed. Some mercenaries who managed to escape from you painted your portraits, warning others to avoid messing with you at all costs.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Paimon doesn't know whether to be flattered or to try and explain that we aren't as scary as the rumors suggest...
Unfortunately, the rules of this tournament state that beast tamers aren't allowed to use their weapons, or even fight each other directly. Your impeccable combat skills won't be any use to you here.
The tournament is about capturing Fungi, training them, and commanding them in combat. There's no way of knowing whether commanding Fungi is a skill you'll be able to master in time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's true... We've never captured a Fungus before, and wouldn't know anything about how to get them to fight.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait a second, you don't look like a staff member. What are you lecturing us for? Who are you anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: The name's Haniyyah. I used to work for the Eremites, taming grumpy Sumpter Beasts. Ended up with a reputation for being a beast tamer, so they got me involved with testing the Wisdom Orb early on.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Anyway, my name ain't worth remembering — I'm just an illiterate nobody, all I'm good for is doing odd jobs for Eremite mercs. Just think of me as another contestant.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I do have a lot of experience taming beasts, though. Want me to teach you?

choices.text: You want to team up with us?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: You guys are worth me getting to know — as allies or opponents, 'cause either way, you can get rid of some obstacles for me in this competition. Of course, I'd prefer allies if possible.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, that was blunt... but also quite honest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's definitely better to have an expert teach us than figure everything out on our own, right? What do you think, should we take her up on her offer?

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Alright then. Take this Wisdom Orb and let's go catch some Fungi at the designated area.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She gets right to the point, doesn't she?

choices.text: You want to size us up?

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: This is where you'll capture your Fungi. The Fungi in this area are highly compatible with the Wisdom Orb, and they're ideal for training and competing with.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: The Wisdom Orb can capture and store Fungi. It also serves as a controller.

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: I recommend giving each Fungus a code name to make commanding them easier. For example, this one next to me is Pyro-1, which means "Pyro Fungus No. 1."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You just go off their element and then number them? Hmm, seems kinda boring to Paimon... Uhh, this Fungus looks pretty lively. Why don't we call it "Bouncy Happyshroom"?

choices.text: Paimon is the best at coming up with names.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Uh... Thanks, but no thanks. I've got my own way of naming them and I'm gonna stick with it. It's simple, straightforward. It helps me with managing them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, you're probably used to calling it Pyro-1 anyway... Alright, we'll stop, but wait until you hear the great names we come up with for our Fungi! You might want to reconsider then.

choices.text: I also have some suggestions if you're interested.

talks.objective: Choose a name for the Fungus

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hee-hehe, Paimon's a Fungi-naming expert! Every one of these will sound really cool when you call them out in the arena!

choices.text: The names you came up with for the second Fungus...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The round hat on this little guy's head kinda looks like a drum, don't ya think? The first thing that came to Paimon's mind when she saw it was... If you hit it on the head, it's definitely gonna go "bing bong"! Hmm... How does the name "Bongo-Head" sound?

choices.text: Hmm, I think "bing bong" is optimistic.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But look how happy it looks! That means it likes the name. Okay then! Bongo-Head it is!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw, Bongo-Head's just like a little puppy... Paimon's never seen this side of a Fungus before.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: From now on, we need to look out for each other, Bongo-Head!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, let's go catch some more Fungi and make a team for Bongo-Head!

choices.text: Probably more like a "squelch."
All three suggestions were the same...

talks.objective: Go to the next Fungi-catching zone
Help the girl you met by chance

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Great, you've now collected all four Fungi. The next step is to use the "Floral Jelly" provided by the organizers to boost your Fungi's abilities. That way, they'll be able to unleash powerful skills during combat...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't believe we're making progress so quickly. It's all thanks to your help, Haniyyah! Alright, let's all return to the arena now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Look, someone's staggering along with a Fungus running circles around her... Is she being attacked?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She's collapsed! Let's go see what's happening!
*whimper*... I can't go on... too weak...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are you hurt? How bad is it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Watch out!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: Pyro-1, take it out!
Wait... it's not an enemy! It's my shroom buddy!
I'm j—just a little too tired to walk right now... But I still need to find three more shroom buddies to qualify for the tournament...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Shroom buddies"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You mean... you're a contestant too?
I wasn't counting on running into other contestants here... Maybe this is the end of the road for me. Twirly-Whirly on its own is no match for you...
Look after Twirly-Whirly for me... take him with you to the top!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, don't give up! It's not like we're a bunch of Eremites trying to steal your Fungi... uh, your shroom buddies. We're better than that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You should at least hang in there until we're in the arena, so we can compete against each other properly!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Haniyyah over here is a professional beast tamer. And despite knowing that we might be her fiercest competitors, she still gave us lots of help and advice!

dialogues.speaker: Haniyyah
dialogues.text: ...Was that supposed to be a compliment?

choices.text: Take it as a compliment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: State your name and mission! Golden Comet and Silver Companion shall gladly come to your aid!
R—Really? Then... could you please help me collect the rest of the four shroom buddies I need? Does this mean my luck is finally starting to change...?

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Um... my name is Layla. I'm just a student in the Rtawahist Darshan, so I don't have any impressive titles or anything... And my goal is to, uh... to make it into the quarterfinals.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: If I can make it to the quarterfinals, I'll get to take my shroom buddies home and delegate some of my physical labor to them. Of course, I'll take good care of them too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh yeah, Paimon read that in the rules somewhere. All quarter-finalists get to take home any Fungi of their choice...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But, what do you mean, "physical labor"? You're a student. Shouldn't you be busy with coursework and writing papers?

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Aah, this is pretty embarrassing, but uh... so I must have some sort of congenital sleep disorder or something, 'cause I can never seem to get enough sleep, and I'm always really low on energy.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Even the smallest amount of exercise makes me... Well, you saw me just now. I get so tired, I collapse from exhaustion. So when I said "physical labor"... I just meant basic stuff like moving books around or fetching things I need from the store...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ah, you don't need to be embarrassed about that, it's totally normal! Paimon delegates chores to {NICKNAME} all the time.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: First she calls them "buddies," then she talks about wanting to live with them... Ridiculous. She sounds just like Elchingen.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: (I wonder what Haniyyah's so annoyed about?)

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: Well. Looks like you've mastered everything already, and moved on to helping others. I'm delighted for you.

response.speaker: Haniyyah
response.text: I'll see you around. Good luck.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Why is Haniyyah leaving all of a sudden?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We haven't thanked you or Pyro-1 yet, Haniyyah! Let's at least go get something to eat together...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: What's wrong? That beast tamer, is she... angry?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... probably not? She's pretty blunt and doesn't make a great first impression, but she's definitely not a bad person! Otherwise, why would she have helped us?

choices.text: Maybe she has something urgent to do...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, we'll see her again, and when we do, let's give her some gifts to show her our gratitude!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In the meantime, let's follow her example by doing our best in the tournament, helping other contestants, and making sure Layla gets to compete!

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Thank you so much! I'll try my best to contribute, too. I don't want to be a burden to you guys.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You help Layla find three more shroom buddies to complete her set...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nicely done! Now that we've put together Layla's team, she should be eligible to take part. Let's head back to the arena and confirm with them.

choices.text: We'll see her again at the tournament...
Paimon's really getting into this.

talks.objective: Return to the Nilotpala Cup Arena

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon see how the qualifying rounds are looking... Great! We're in a different group from Layla, so we won't have to compete against each other in the early stages of the competition!

dialogues.speaker: Layla
dialogues.text: Actually... I hope I don't have to fight you guys in the later stages, either...

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Oh? Hello there, little ones.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Sure enough, you're at the center of the action once again. You two truly are like the main characters in your own light novel.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: M—Miko? What are you doing here? Is Paimon hallucinating?

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Hehe, this tournament was advertised far and wide, including all the way over in Inazuma. They even handed out flyers in front of Yae Publishing House.

dialogues.speaker: Yae Miko
dialogues.text: Don't you think a tournament like this makes a perfect candidate for light novel treatment?

choices.text: It does seem like a good place to find source material.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Yae Publishing House is working on a bestseller that, if all goes to plan, will stay a bestseller for the next fifty years. The theme is "friendship and rivalry," so we decided to bring our up-and-coming author, Souka here, to gather some inspiration.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: I, of course, need to ensure my writers' manuscripts are up to par. So, I will be taking part in the tournament myself to get a little taste of what it's like.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Here's my little partner in crime. Souka named it "Blitzara" — I think it's rather good. Very distinctive.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Who knew there'd be such a big turnout? Even Miko's here...

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Souka, come say hi to the little ones. They are set to be some of the fiercest competition you face in the tournament. You should put them in your novel as major characters.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: Yes, Chief Editor!

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: For the s—sake of my readership, I... w—won't back down! I'll b—b—beat... b—beat you!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: See you in the arena!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! Just 'cause you're with Miko doesn't mean we'll go easy on you!

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Ooh, yes, more of that! Do you feel that, Souka? Declaring a challenge to your arch-enemy-in-the-making before the competition begins is a key plot device that helps build dramatic tension.

response.speaker: Souka
response.text: I—I wouldn't say I'm feeling that, exactly! J—Just thinking about competing against Her Excellency's Hanamizaka tour confidante is m—making me so nervous, I'm losing my, m—my, my m—mind...

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Hmm, in that case, head back to the inn and capture your nervous breakdown in writing while it's still fresh. This'll make excellent source material, too.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: She's... terrifying... but she also seems really dedicated to her craft. I hope we can be friends.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: And who is this softly spoken little lady?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She's our new friend, Layla. We met her while we were out capturing Fungi.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Layla's entering the tournament 'cause she wants to take her trained Fungi back home to live with her. Her goal is to make it to the quarterfinals!

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Training Fungi... and then domesticating them?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: How fascinating... You must be full of secrets. There's an intriguing story to be told here, no doubt.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: I'm Yae Miko, a light novel editor — purely out of personal interest, and right now, what I'm most interested in is you... Nice to meet you. The pleasure is all mine.

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Uhh... I have no idea how to respond to that...

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: Traveler, Paimon, I really appreciate all your help!

response.speaker: Layla
response.text: But, I wanna get to know my four shroom buddies a little better and prepare for the qualifiers, so... I'll go do some training now!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't push yourself too hard, Layla! You'll end up collapsing from exhaustion again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Miko, what are you doing, scaring our new friend off like that!

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Oh? Am I really so terrifying? Well then, I'll simply have to talk to her again another time to clear things up...

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: But that can wait... Judging from your expression, it seems like you have something you want to say to me, little one.

choices.text: What are you really doing in Sumeru?

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: I'm comforted to know that you didn't lose your heads amidst the hype, and you're not just in this to have some fun. Unfortunately though... it appears that we're about to be interrupted.

response.speaker: Kautilya
response.text: Guuji Yae! What an honor to finally meet you! We're so privileged that our tournament is your first destination in Sumeru!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Isn't that the organizer? And that super-rich businessman is here too...

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Goodness, I presume that the tournament is proceeding very smoothly indeed? Otherwise, how would the host and sponsor themselves have the time to spare to chat with contestants one on one?

response.speaker: Kautilya
response.text: How you jest, Guuji Yae! Those such as your esteemed self deserve nothing short of the most lavish reception Sumeru has to offer.

response.speaker: Kautilya
response.text: I see you've already had the chance to try out the Wisdom Orb? What are your thoughts on the future prospects of this technology? You know, with your blessing, it can be introduced into Inazuma, allowing you to swiftly resolve the situation of—

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Ahem... Right now, I am nothing but an ordinary editor-in-chief. I'm here to enjoy my vacation and gather some inspiration along the way, and if I can at all help it, I'd rather not concern myself with such weighty topics as the future fate of nascent technologies...

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: Don't be so pushy, Mr. Kautilya. Droning on about the Akademiya's business ambitions is hardly respectful to our honored guest who has traveled all the way from the Land of Thunder to be here.

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: Not to mention that Guuji Yae is busy catching up with her friends. I daresay it was both unnecessary and discourteous to interrupt their conversation like this.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: A most pertinent remonstration coming from you, Mr. Elchingen. You do conduct yourself in such an unobtrusive manner... much as you have in your entire career, quietly amassing an enormous fortune while remaining almost entirely unknown...

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: Why, to hear such high praise from the great Guuji Yae is more prestige than I could ever hope for. Please, should you require anything at all, do not hesitate to seek my assistance. I will do everything within my ability to make your stay in Sumeru an enjoyable one.

response.speaker: Elchingen
response.text: Also... To have the renowned Traveler here at the tournament is an unexpected delight. I'm very much looking forward to seeing you in action.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Um... Thank you...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Miko, they're here to do business with you, right? Should you really be turning them away like this? Especially the rich guy? Paimon thinks working with him could have a lot of advantages for Yae Publishing House...

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Promoting an entirely new event throughout all of Teyvat so rapidly would be an impossible feat for any ordinary businessman. I, for one, do not wish for Yae Publishing House to be the subordinate partner in a business relationship with him.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Besides, the tournament has only just begun. Who knows whether it will go on to be a success? I want to focus on trying to enjoy myself, while keeping one eye open for potential liabilities.

choices.text: Potential liabilities...

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Fungi may look adorable, but they carry potent elemental energy inside their bodies. Letting one's guard down around these creatures would be an unwise move, don't you think?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So it wasn't just us! Yeah, we started out with some safety concerns about this event, but the Wisdom Orb seems pretty amazing!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: At least, all the Fungi we used it on have been very well-behaved, like our Bongo-Head here. Seems we don't need to be too nervous after all.

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: Oh, Paimon, you're just as carefree and enthusiastic as ever. Well, it's about time for me to get into character. As a contestant, I need to go and get ready for the tournament...

response.speaker: Yae Miko
response.text: See you in the qualifiers. Blitzara, say goodbye to our friends.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Coming here was a great idea! Look at us, making new friends, bumping into Miko... This competition is shaping up to be a whole lot of fun!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Come on, let's go get some Floral Jelly for Bongo-Head's training, like Haniyyah suggested!

choices.text: So you've noticed.
What's going on behind the scenes of this tournament?
There are lots of stories you could tell about this.

talks.objective: Go to the Floral Jelly vendor

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Ah, the champions-to-be, here at long last! Come on now, use the Floral Jelly and awaken your Fungi's true potential!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Champions-to-be? Hehe, thanks for the compliment! So you've heard about us too?

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Of course, I was standing right next to you when you collected your Wisdom Orb. I couldn't find a convenient opportunity to introduce myself, as Haniyyah was busy explaining the tournament to you...

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: With an expert mentor like Haniyyah, I'm sure you'll become excellent beast-tamers in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If even the staff are singing her praises, Haniyyah must really know what she's doing! Well, all the more reason to give it our all!

talks.objective: Go to the Special Training Grounds

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Greetings, the two of you. Do you want to train your Fungi, or are you looking for someone to answer your questions?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We want to train Fungi.

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Okay, make sure to use the Floral Jelly according to the instructions in the recipe.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You are...

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Truth be told, I used to be an ordinary merchant. I studied the promotional principles of commercial events and learned how to cater to the needs and wants of customers.

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: After Mr. Elchingen heard about my background, he hired me to come here and help him, his employees, and Kautilya organize this competition.

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: His employees are all extremely sharp. They transformed Mr. Elchingen's traditional business into something suitable for hosting a competition in a very short period of time.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: Traditional business?

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Yeah, I hear that Mr. Elchingen used to primarily be in the grocery business. I'm not too sure about the details though.

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: It's amazing that a typical merchant could grow into such a wealthy individual. It's inspiring!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So Elchingen is actually pretty open-minded... You're a really hard worker too!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You know, this is also the first time we've met a tycoon from Fontaine. He really doesn't give off a special first impression.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He wears Sumeru merchant clothes even though he's from Fontaine. Paimon didn't see any expensive accessories either. You really can't tell that he's rich...

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: See? That's all just proof that Mr. Elchingen is a wonderful person.

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: He's been in Sumeru for a really long time and has adopted the local way of life. He's also very low-key in everything he does.

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Mr. Elchingen even eats and chats with ordinary employees as if we're his friends!

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: I think the reason he hired me instead of seeking the assistance of a professional merchant is partially to avoid malicious competition.

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: If he went all out promoting the competition, there might've been other wealthy people interested in investing and sharing a piece of the pie. If that happened, the competition might have lost its original purpose.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds really nice! Paimon hopes to find a boss like that if Paimon were to ever look for a job!

choices.text: But Paimon, it's not like you have to do any work...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What are you talking about!? You're different!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In our relationship, there's no need to talk about trivial stuff like Mora, right?

choices.text: Am I not a good boss?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The name, "Floral Jelly"...

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Ha, I know what you're gonna say!

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: I hear that the Vahumana researchers studied manuscripts from all over Teyvat and came to the preliminary conclusion that using certain suffixes in a name makes it sound extremely cute. I have to say, I kinda agree!

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Kautilya repeatedly emphasized that his research is "glorious and ground-breaking," and that it needed a name that's out of this world... But Mr. Elchingen rejected all of his proposals.

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Mr. Elchingen believed that since most people find Fungi to be cute little creatures, it would only be fitting if the official names used in the competition followed suit.

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: After several heated debates, the name "Floral Jelly" was retained, along with the easy-to-understand name, "Wisdom Orb."

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: But Mr. Elchingen did let Kautilya decide the other names. It's a good thing that most of those names are only used to communicate with future collaborators and aren't used by the contestants.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What's with this Kautilya guy? It seems like he's always trying to show off how amazing he is. It seems like he's really pushy.

choices.text: He shouldn't do that, even if he truly is amazing.

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: You think so too, huh?

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: He doesn't get along with many of the staff. Even Mr. Elchingen has to make compromises with him at times.

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: If it weren't for his irreplaceable technology and Mr. Elchingen continuously comforting the staff... the team of organizers probably would've fallen apart a long time ago.

response.speaker: Balfour
response.text: It's obvious why Kautilya kept running into dead ends before Mr. Elchingen sponsored him financially.

choices.text: Elchingen is clearly more reasonable.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the competition...

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: You can go and take a look at the promotion board if there's anything else you're unsure about!

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: The staff will update the progression of the competition on the promotion board. I hear that they're planning to include interactive events as well. The events will begin once the popularity of the competition reaches a certain point.

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: They might even start to sell a competition highlight "film" after the competition progresses to a certain point.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What determines if the competition is popular enough...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds like a pretty harsh requirement, don't you think? The competition venue isn't exactly outstanding. You sure it's gonna work?

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Oh, I wouldn't worry about that at all. The center of Sumeru commerce, Wikala Funduq, is right next to the arena, and the bridge to the harbor is not too far off either. Any traffic that moves through the area will definitely be able to see the venue.

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Besides, we've also put up a promotional poster on the bulletin board in Sumeru City. Many of the competitors and audience are here because they saw it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ohh, we saw it too! So you were the one that put up the advertisement on that bulletin board!

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Haha, it's pretty good, right? I must say, writing marketing material is one of my strong suits!

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: I'm doing some of the reporting for the competition too. I'll do my best to describe your performance excitedly!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It feels like you're in charge of a lot of the work that's being done here. From managing the Floral Jelly and organizing the events to writing promotional material and reporting...

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Oh, it's nothing compared to the salary that Mr. Elchingen is paying me. I'm being paid ten times what I was making before... Ahem!

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: Anyways, Mr. Elchingen said it best! He said that those capable should take on more responsibility. I'm more than willing to give my all to a boss like him.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Balfour
dialogues.text: I'll see you next time! Good luck!
